name: const unsafe fn as_uninit_slice < 'a > (self) -> Option < & 'a [MaybeUninit < T >] >
rule: If self is non-null, the total slice size self.len() * size_of::<T>() must be no larger than isize::MAX bytes, even if the result is unused.
api: impl < T > * const [T] { const unsafe fn as_uninit_slice < 'a > (self) -> core::option::Option < & 'a [MaybeUninit < T >] > }
